steps: Install the Swagbucks mobile app from your official app store.
Sign in with your existing Swagbucks account (or create a free one — it is the same account as the main Swagbucks route).
Complete earning activities in the app: surveys, offers, games, videos, and other listed categories.
SB accrue to your single Swagbucks balance — the same balance as the web route.
Redeem SB for gift cards or other rewards once you reach Swagbucks' redemption levels.
timing: SB accrue per completed activity; earning categories and pay vary and are not guaranteed.
